through financial or credit assistance, in support o f production 
programs.

ing for new or restored communities.

situation, analyze resource estimates in relation to estimated require­
ments in order to identify problem areas and develop appropriate 
recommendations and programs. Provide data and assistance before 
and after attack for national resources evaluation purposes o f the 
Office o f Emergency Planning.

versions.research_rationale:
EO 11004 (1962-02-16; Assigning certain emergency preparedness functions to the Housing and Home Finance Administrator): the held Federal Register text was checked against its heading, numbered sections and closing date, and searched for expiry, "until", termination and effective-date wording. The order assigns continuing emergency preparedness planning functions and its own terms contain no end date or end condition. The end is EO 11490 of October 28, 1969, whose Sec. 3015 revokes the order by number; the end source is the American Presidency Project transcription of EO 11490 (APP node 255823, Common Crawl capture 2025-11-18T01:11:34Z), whose Sec. 3015 list agrees with the Federal Register text of 34 FR 17567 onward (issue of October 30, 1969) read for corroboration. The held texts citing this order's number were searched with the repository number lookup and no earlier revocation or supersession was found. The order also revoked earlier issuances by its own closing sentence where one is stated, a one-time act recorded as a separate scope. The legal cutoff is 2026-10-14; no continuing predicate is needed for a NO order.
